title: Mum's Youngest — EN/IT/DE (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The youngest one grows up watching two ahead
He learned from every move they made
But Joel always had his own direction
A quieter path, a different kind of brave

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Andò in Zimbabwe, tornò con Kerri [He went to Zimbabwe, came home with Kerri]
Dissi — figlio, è lei quella giusta? Lui sorrise soltanto [I said — son, is this the one? He just smiled]
Lei viene da una fattoria, i suoi genitori Jeff e Jill [She's from a farm, her parents Jeff and Jill]
E adesso hanno una figlia che canta con uno stile sottile [And now they have a daughter who sings with a unique style]

[Chorus — English]
My youngest one, the one who went the furthest
My youngest one, the one who found his first
Ari's got a voice that stops the morning
My youngest one — I always knew you'd learn

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Er hat mich einmal aus dem Krankenhaus angerufen [He rang me from the hospital once]
Er sagte — Mama, Jack hat mich mit dem Buggy erwischt [He said — Mum, Jack got me on the buggy bad]
Ich sagte — Joel, so fährt man keinen Buggy [I said — Joel, that's not how you drive a buggy]
Er sagte — Mama, ich fuhr nicht, das war Jack [He said — Mum, I wasn't driving, that was Jack]

[Verse 3 — English]
His Oma's voice is somewhere in his singing
That's how you know — he was never alone

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The gardens still growing
Il giardino sta ancora crescendo [The garden is still growing]
Der Garten wächst noch [The garden is still growing]
My youngest one
